claim_limits: This harness is research qualification infrastructure, not production deployment infrastructure.
100k qualification refers to journal event count, separately reporting material-operation count.
Python tracemalloc is coordinator-allocation evidence, not OCCT worker RSS.
Linux live STEP soak does not qualify Windows STEP execution.
No source, audio, body, journal, lineage, tolerance, or provenance contract is weakened to obtain a pass.

hypotheses.claim: The accepted RCS-019 canonicalizer produces identical programme-level results on pinned Windows/MSVC and Linux toolchain runners.
hypotheses.falsified_by: Any vector status/value/signature difference or refusal divergence.

hypotheses.claim: Process-isolated provider faults are contained and a clean job succeeds after timeout, crash, or forced kill.
hypotheses.falsified_by: Coordinator failure, orphaned tracked child, fault misclassification, or failed post-fault clean job.

hypotheses.claim: Programme-authority replay remains deterministic through 100000 journal events for lathe, mill, and mixed-provider stress histories.
hypotheses.falsified_by: Repeated replay signature/body/lineage/status disagreement, failure to complete the tier, or unbounded deferred state.

hypotheses.claim: Deletion or corruption of derived cache state does not alter replayed programme authority.
hypotheses.falsified_by: Replay signature, body mapping, lineage, or status depends on disposable cache content.

hypotheses.claim: Repeated live Linux STEP export/read-back preserves the accepted RCS-022 engineering-level outcome without manufacturing Layer-D qualification.
hypotheses.falsified_by: Run-to-run programme-level export/parser/consumer/body/check divergence, adversarial-control miss, or status other than the measured Layer-D result.

hypotheses.claim: The research coordinator shows no obvious monotonic allocation or latency pathology over the bounded CI campaign.
hypotheses.falsified_by: Campaign failure, runaway allocation, or material repeat-to-repeat drift requiring minimization; timing/memory are observational rather than cross-platform equality gates.

qualification_rules.windows_step_scope: A live exact-pinned OCCT 8.0.1 Windows STEP soak is not pre-assumed. If absent, it must be named as a Gate-5 blocker rather than silently inferred from Linux.

title: Windows/Linux scale, soak and fault-recovery qualification
